_comment: Non-secret configuration. Secrets live in .env only.
This tracker runs ENTIRELY on this machine. There is no cloud routine, no
git remote and no artifact board -- all three were removed 2026-09-11.
portal_url is the STABLE team link on the UC reports portal (VPN-only).
publish.cmd REPLACES that URL in place every run, so the link never changes.
Reads require UC VPN: off-VPN viewers get 403.
Adapters whose volume NEVER enters the dashboard -- user decision
2026-09-09: 'dont track Not trackable (SELF), Porter and Unknown
(Easy_GO, Ripplr), they should never enter the dashboard'.
Shipments resolving to one of these are cohorted 'excluded' at intake, so
they are absent from alerts, carrier scorecards, worst lanes and every
queue -- not merely flagged. They survive as ONE reconciling figure in the
coverage funnel, because a funnel that does not account for its own input
would let the board claim coverage of a shrunken denominator.
DTDC is deliberately NOT here: its volume is real and its performance is
still measurable from Uniware's own tracking columns.
Carriers we poll directly, so Uniware's own tracking columns must
NEVER supply their status -- measured 2026-09-14: of 25 Blue Dart
AWBs whose board status came from Uniware, 22 were already DELIVERED
at the carrier and none agreed. A shipment in this list with no
successful poll shows as 'not checked with carrier', not as a stale
Uniware value.
Shadowfax and Delhivery are deliberately NOT here: with no API token
they cannot be polled, so Uniware is all there is. Those rows keep
their status but are flagged UNVERIFIED on the board and in the CSV.
Add a carrier here as soon as it has working live tracking.
